channel.title: GiveOwl – Giveaways & sweepstakes in Australia
channel.description: Every listing links to the organizer’s official rules. GiveOwl never collects your entries.

item.title: Coco & Harley $250 Gift Voucher Giveaway – Coco & Harley
item.description: Prize: $250 AUD Coco & Harley gift voucher (store credit). Deadline: October 25, 2026. Fill in the giveaway entry form on the Coco & Harley homepage (joins their email community). Free, one entry per person, Australian residents 18+. Closes 11:59pm AEDT 25 October 2026

item.title: Hammer Roo October Giveaway: win the Maker Pack – Hammer Roo Woodworks Pty Ltd
item.description: Prize: Hammer Roo Maker Pack (RRP $609.90) plus 4 × $50 Hammer Roo vouchers; total $809.90. Deadline: October 29, 2026. Enter your email in the form on the giveaway page (one entry per person). No purchase necessary. Australian residents 18+. Closes 11:59pm AEST Thursday 29 October 2026; draw 2 November

item.title: Youi x The Block Viewers Choice: Win 1 of 4 $10K Freedom Vouchers – Nine Entertainment Co. & Youi
